title: The Red Callender Six on Sunset and Monarch, 1945
summary: He lists the sextet with Sweets Edison, Herbie Haymer and Les Paul as Paul Leslie, recorded for Eddie Laguna.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yeah. I wouldn't know how... I'd have to check on that. But I see one thing here that I remember very well that was interesting, the Red Callender Six. On that one I had Harry Edison, Herbie Haymer (remember him?)...,

...Arnold Ross, and Les Paul, who changed his name to Paul Leslie because he was under contract to somebody, and Shadow Wilson on drums. This was in 1945. One of the things was "These Foolish Things"... Ah, this was on the Sunset label. Eddie Laguna. Remember him?
Yes, of course. Eddie Laguna was my neighbor here in the Canyon.
"Get Happy", "I Cover the Waterfront" and "Lady, Be Good." That was on Monarch, and the rest of these things were on the Swing label, which later became the Sunset label, I think.
And I wrote these liner notes for Eddie for Monarch.
